Container.Name: bahi
Container.Overview: Bahi puts your TallyPrime books on your phone, from your own server: a free, self-hosted alternative to Credflow and Livekeeping. A small sync app on the Windows PC that runs TallyPrime (Bahi Sync) copies ledgers, vouchers, stock, bill-wise outstanding and GST data to this container, and you open it in the Android app or as a web app on any phone or computer. See ledgers and statements, search vouchers, track dues with ageing and follow-ups, stock by godown, Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss, GST summary, cash and bank book, bank reconciliation and sales analysis. Share Tally-style invoice and ledger PDFs (with e-invoice QR and e-way bill) on WhatsApp, send customers their own ledger link and UPI payment requests, get a Telegram morning summary, scan barcodes, and enter receipts, payments, orders, sales, purchases and new stock items from the phone. Staff logins with your approval, several companies, nightly backups (also to Google Drive or OneDrive). Bahi never deletes or changes anything in Tally: it only reads, and phone entries only ever go in as new vouchers or new stock items.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: tally tallyprime accounting gst ledger invoice credflow livekeeping india
Container.Requires: A Windows PC running TallyPrime with its data server on (port 9000) and Bahi Sync installed. Setup guide: https://github.com/bdlnaredi/bahi/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md. Set an app password and a sync token below. To use it away from home, put it behind Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the app and for Bahi Sync on the Tally PC

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Synced Tally data, phone entries, settings and nightly backups

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Owner password for the app (staff get their own logins inside the app)

Config.Name: Sync token
Config.Description: A long random secret; type the same one into Bahi Sync on the Tally PC

Config.Name: Backup time
Config.Description: Time of the nightly backup (24-hour, HH:MM)

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for backups, summaries and reminders (IST-5:30 is India)
